messages:
Vikram S: Noting a parity issue causing sampleapp onboarding failures for a few customers. Using TS SDK 2.0.3. REST works fine.
Vikram S: Repro: click 'Import credentials' -> spinner -> network shows 401s repeatedly. HAR attached.
Asha R: can you paste the SDK call + headers?
Vikram S: minimal SDK call:
```ts
await client.auth.verify({ key: 'sk_test_xxx' })
```
Captured SDK headers:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx
User-Agent: Redwood-TS/2.0.3
# X-Client-App header MISSING
```
Working curl that returns 200:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/verify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -H "X-Client-App: sampleapp/ts-2.1" \
  -d '{"key":"sk_test_xxx"}'
```
Ben K: couple separate parity gaps: 1) SDK strips unknown headers (so X-Client-App is dropped) and our server routes differ when that header is absent; 2) retry middleware erroneously retries on 401 which keeps UI hanging; 3) admin endpoint admin.getModelVersions exists in REST but is missing from the TS SDK surface.
Asha R: also seeing parameter drift: REST model version endpoints accept `version` and `model_version` (legacy) while SDK only accepts `modelVersion` (camelCase). Leads to 400s when downstream code passes one of the others. We should accept aliases and normalize.
Vikram S: another small but important bit: REST accepts an `idempotency_key` on createModelVersion; SDK does not expose it, which has caused duplicate version uploads during onboarding retries.
qa-bot: Auto-created ticket DEVEX-7310: "ts-sdk parity: header passthrough, retry-on-401, admin.getModelVersions, param aliasing, idempotency_key"
Ben K: Proposed actions:
- Remove 401/403 from default retry policy (only 502/503/504 + network errors; 429 optional for idempotent ops).
- Preserve unknown headers end-to-end.
- Add admin.getModelVersions to TS SDK and expose modelVersion/version/model_version aliases normalized to `version`.
- Expose optional `idempotency_key` on write/create calls.
Asha R: I'll add a minimal e2e smoke test in sampleapp that simulates invalid creds and asserts we surface 401 immediately (no retry) and that outbound requests include X-Client-App. That should catch regressions.
Vikram S: timeline? This is blocking a pilot.
Ben K: I'll split the work: retry/header PR first (small). Asha/Ops will add smoke test. I'll follow up with the admin surface + aliasing PR. ETA for first PR: ~4 hours.
devx-bot: Linked HAR: https://internal-redwood/hars/1955551234.har. Labels: devex, sdk, onboarding, priority-high.
Vikram S: thanks all, will validate once staged package is available. :raised_hands:
